title: Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> for CEK is correct and consistently applied
description: The CEK (content-encryption key) is wrapped in Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> throughout decrypt.rs and encrypt.rs. find_and_decrypt_cek returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, ecdh_wrap_cek zeroes the KEK, and encrypt_aes_cbc returns the CEK as Zeroizing. This is consistently applied and correct — the CEK will be scrubbed from memory on drop even if decrypt() or encrypt() returns an error partway through (thanks to Rust's drop semantics). Good security hygiene.
